entries.title: Keep local shared-data queries within their project window
entries.description: Add project and review read APIs for trusted local app windows. Recheck the current window and project after queued work, return only approved fields, and reject cross-project reads. Cross-PC connections and remote writes remain unavailable.

entries.title: Show clear errors when selecting Codex CLI
entries.description: Show the original CLI-selection failure reason without Electron's internal method prefix. Keep existing executable settings and diagnostic details available when a new selection fails.
